sampling: prose paragraphs numbered 1-25 after front matter (headings, images, tables, display equations not counted); took paragraphs 3,6,9,12,15,18,21,24, then wrapped to 2,5,8,10,11 plus the two tables they introduce

A: Headings are topic names (L18 '## 연구 배경', L28 '## 제안 방법', L46 '## 구현 방식'); acceptable for the fixed five-section summary outline. Front matter, math delimiters and tables render correctly; description 127 chars.
B: L42 'Adam을 쓸 때 ... 그래서 $$\alpha$$가 학습률과 같은 역할을 합니다. 그래서 저자들은 처음 시도한 $$r$$ 값을 ...' -- two consecutive '그래서' plus English default verb '역할을 합니다'; rewrite: '$$\alpha$$를 바꾸는 것은 학습률을 바꾸는 것과 거의 같으므로, 저자들은 처음 시도한 $$r$$ 값을 $$\alpha$$로 두고 튜닝하지 않았습니다.'
L89 '그보다 큰 rank로', L93 '더 큰 rank로 학습한 행렬' -- English 'rank' mixed with '랭크' used everywhere else.
L20 '전체 파인튜닝(fine-tuning)' re-glosses a term already glossed at L16; L40 '어댑터(adapter)' re-glosses L22.
L64 '... 낫다는 해석입니다' noun frame; rewrite: '... 낫다고 해석합니다.'
C: L40 repeats L22-26 almost verbatim (adapter definition, GPT-2 medium on Quadro RTX8000, 'over 30%' slow-down in the online setting) inside the LoRA architecture paragraph -- reads as a stitched fragment.
L78 '저자들은 연구 배경에서 소개한 MNLI 저데이터 과제를 썼습니다' -- the 연구 배경 section (L18-26) never mentions MNLI or a low-data task; false cross-reference.
L70 '앞서 든 예처럼 GPT-3를 WikiSQL에 맞춘다면' -- no earlier GPT-3/WikiSQL example exists; the running example is introduced as if already set up.
D: L44 '규모를 가늠하기 위해 가상의 계산을 해 보겠습니다' promises a sizing example but stays symbolic (d x k vs d+k); plugging d=k=12,288 would give the concrete ratio the reader needs.
Subspace-similarity formula (L91-93) is well explained with every symbol defined -- good timing.
E: The headline GPT-3 175B result (paper Table 4: LoRA 4.7M 73.4 / 91.7 / 53.8/29.8/45.9 vs FT 73.8 / 89.5 / 52.0/28.0/44.5) has no table or numbers; L70 says only '같거나 더 높았습니다'. The two tables present (weight-type ablation, low-data MNLI) are secondary results.
Tables at L54-62 and L80-85 match the paper cell for cell; figures are referred to descriptively.
F: No wrong or unsupported number found in the sample.
L97 '이 행렬은 모델이 원래 가진 표현 가운데 SQL 생성에 필요한 방향을 증폭할 뿐입니다' states as fact an extrapolation to WikiSQL of the paper's general Table 7 / H.3 finding (measured on layer 48 Wq, not per task); minor overreach.
L16/L70 '세 데이터셋 모두 ... 같거나 더 높은' follows the paper's own wording ('matches or exceeds'), although LoRA 4.7M WikiSQL 73.4 is below FT 73.8 (within the stated +/-0.5%); not deducted beyond this note.
U1: All five questions covered, but results omit the main GPT-3 numbers, the 10,000x trainable-parameter reduction, and any RoBERTa/DeBERTa/GPT-2 results; a reader cannot quote what LoRA scored.
U2: TL;DR is plain prose without math (4 sentences, slightly long). One grounded limitation (L99, L101). Filler: duplicated latency paragraph L40; distilled results table is the low-data one, not the headline.
